entities.name: Registration procedure
entities.description: Procedure during which UE indicates support and preference for CIoT 5GS optimizations and network indicates accepted optimizations.

entities.name: 5GS update type IE
entities.description: Information element in REGISTRATION REQUEST message containing SMS requested bit.

entities.name: 5GS registration result IE
entities.description: Information element in REGISTRATION ACCEPT message containing SMS allowed bit.

entities.name: Control plane CIoT 5GS optimization
entities.description: Enables efficient transport of user data or SMS messages over control plane via AMF without triggering user-plane resources establishment.

entities.name: User plane CIoT 5GS optimization
entities.description: Enables change from 5GMM-IDLE mode to 5GMM-CONNECTED mode over 3GPP access without using service request procedure.

entities.name: N3 data transfer
entities.description: Feature that enables data transfer over N3 interface, required when supporting user plane CIoT 5GS optimization.

entities.name: NB-N1 mode
entities.description: UE operating mode where UE always indicates support for control plane CIoT 5GS optimization and has restrictions on emergency services.

entities.name: WB-N1 mode
entities.description: UE operating mode with different support requirements for CIoT 5GS optimizations compared to NB-N1 mode.

entities.name: UE preference indication
entities.description: UE separately indicates preference for control plane or user plane CIoT 5GS optimization, considered as request to use.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE during registration procedure containing CIoT optimization indications.

entities.name: REGISTRATION ACCEPT
entities.description: Message sent by network indicating accepted CIoT 5GS optimizations.

relations.description: Registration procedure includes sending REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
Registration procedure includes receiving REGISTRATION ACCEPT message.
REGISTRATION REQUEST message contains 5GS update type IE.
REGISTRATION ACCEPT message contains 5GS registration result IE.
UE in NB-N1 mode always indicates support for control plane CIoT 5GS optimization.
UE preference indication guards whether user plane CIoT 5GS optimization is requested.
If UE supports user plane CIoT 5GS optimization, it shall also support N3 data transfer.
Registration procedure includes UE indicating preference for CIoT optimizations.
